references.text: Describes the same event where Jesus' brothers go to the feast first, while Jesus follows in secret, establishing the context for his hidden arrival.
Continues the theme of Jesus' secret presence at the feast, where he avoids public revelation due to fear of the Jews.
Refers to Jesus' secret teaching in the temple during the feast, which is a direct consequence of his hidden arrival described in 7:10.
Describes a similar situation where Jesus withdraws and lives in hiding to avoid capture, paralleling his behavior at the festival.
Summarizes Jesus' period of going into hiding and not appearing publicly until his time had come, a theme introduced in 7:10.
